coaching.headline: We won every lane, then gave away a full wipe and two free majors before conversion pulled it home.
coaching.team: Every lane read favored, and the early game backed it up: Early Fangtooth wins built a lead, even though the 2v1 loss to Rampage at 2.7 minutes was the wrong fight to take that early. The lead cracked between 24.3 and 25.7, when all five players died in succession and the enemy took the resulting Primal Fangtooth. Two more majors were handed over for nothing: Genesis Core at 28 and another Primal Fangtooth at 43 both fell with nobody of ours dead — five living players just weren't there. Even so, the team out-converted the opponent, converting five of six won fights against their five of eight, and closed 13 towers to 7. A clean 0-4 loss at Orb Prime in the 41.6-minute fight came while sitting far ahead on items, proof that stretch was a decision problem, not a gear one. Next game: hold vision and get bodies to a major before it spawns, instead of arriving only after the fight meant to stop it.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Five deaths between 24.3 and 25.7 handed the enemy their Primal Fangtooth and erased the early lead; the fights the team did win still converted at five of six, which is what pulled the game back.
coaching.whatWorked: Conversion: five of six won fights cashed inside 90 seconds against the opponent's five of eight — that gap is why 13 towers fell to their 7.

lines: Lead story: Healed through fights. 568 healing a minute, more than 98% of valmont mid players this patch.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one valmont touched shortened Exsanguinate, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 2.9s late); fight right after Exsanguinate is spent.
Exsanguinate at top rank: 5s base, about 2.9s by the end (42% shorter) from 75 ability haste: Megacosm 10, Lifebinder 15, Soulbearer 8, Lotus 42.
19 takedowns (9 kills, 10 assists) fed: Lotus (Eternal), Hemophagia (passive).
Overseer (Exalted): Enhance your Ultimate Ability: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
valmont dealt 77,549 hero damage, 33% of their team's, with +550 magical power from items.

Penetration: Overseer 8, Wraith Leggings 11; against Riktor (level 17 estimated: about 135 magical armor, 116 after penetration) and Eden (level 17 estimated: about 43 magical armor, 24 after penetration) that is about 9% and 15% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Overseer (item): Ultimate: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 2.5% of Target's Max Health as Damage over 3s. Additional applications refresh the duration.
Megacosm (item): On dealing Ability Damage to Heroes: Deal 6% of Target's Bonus Health as Damage over 3s.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
Immaculate (Eternal minor): Gain 10% Damage Reduction above 85% current health.

Sustain: 19% magical lifesteal; Orb Of Enlightenment: On Ability Cast: Restore 3% Missing Health over 5s.; Overseer: Ultimate: Deals 15% more damage. Heals you for 25% of the damage dealt to Heroes.; Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; 26,712 healing recorded.
Toughness: +500 health; took 83,669 damage, mitigated 42,402, died 9 times.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 4 effects on one trigger: Overseer, Lifebinder, Soulbearer, Sanguine Banquet.
Stack (Every ability hit set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Megacosm, Wraith Leggings. valmont has 4 damaging abilities, and 75 ability haste brought them back 43% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Countered? 2 of the 4 players valmont killed built magical armor (Riktor, Rampage). Anti-heal on Eden, Riktor, Rampage. We killed valmont 9 times.
Copy it? Too few valmont midlane games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.
